Title: Preserve and diagnose current version
Description: Record the deployed baseline, data cutoffs, input hashes, generated counts, duplicates, eligibility problems, and stale artifacts without changing public logic.
Acceptance: A reproducible baseline audit and lineage manifest cover every current registry row and all generated outputs.
Test_Method: Re-run the audit and compare deterministic summaries and hashes.
Notes: Phase 1 complete; deterministic rerun passed and report rendered. Checkpoint before P2.

Title: Refresh and deduplicate registry
Description: Recheck retained projects against February 2026 GEM and current authoritative sources; resolve duplicates and project phases.
Acceptance: Every retained record is current, uniquely identified, dated, sourced, and either resolved or explicitly flagged.
Test_Method: Schema, URL, duplicate, contradiction, and row-count validations.
Notes: No countries added; documentary recheck in progress. | 2026-10-05: Partial documentary refresh: 14 reviewed, 36 flagged; two aliases resolved. Complete February 2026 tracker reconciliation remains open.

Title: Separate evidence dimensions
Description: Replace the overloaded public label with claim, observation, schedule, grid-context, and review dimensions.
Acceptance: The schema prevents coverage gaps or missing dates from becoming negative delivery conclusions.
Notes: Migration must preserve provenance. | 2026-10-05: v2 evidence contract separates claim, observation, schedule, grid and review; date precision and exclusion tests pass.

Title: Rebuild observation layer efficiently
Description: Reuse GRW, screen eligibility, inspect previews, and pilot targeted inference on Tengeh, Sidrap, and Claveria before any scaling.
Acceptance: No unnecessary imagery jobs; direct observations and estimates are separated; pilot results include resource measurements.
Test_Method: Golden-case review plus bytes, runtime, cache, and retained-storage audit.

Title: Replace greedy matching
Description: Generate reviewable candidates with phase, geometry, timing, accuracy, and onshore-offshore constraints.
Acceptance: Every published match is manually approved and rejected candidates remain auditable.
Test_Method: Matching unit tests and golden-case regression tests.

Title: Reframe grid context
Description: Rename grid readiness and limit claims to what open infrastructure evidence supports.
Acceptance: No proximity signal is described as connection, evacuation capacity, commissioning, or delivery without an authoritative source.
Test_Method: Content assertions and row-level evidence review.
Notes: Unassessed remains explicit. | 2026-10-05: 50 current context records; 15 cached proximity records. No readiness/connection scores. Unknown OSM snapshot date remains explicit.

Description: Replace invalid metrics and expose cutoffs, denominators, freshness, sources, review status, downloads, limitations, and accessibility improvements.
Acceptance: Every displayed metric has a valid denominator and the interface communicates uncertainty clearly.
Test_Method: Frontend tests, accessibility review, responsive review, and content assertions.

Title: Make repository reproducible
Description: Lock dependencies, remove hard-coded runtimes, add tests, CI, documentation, and licensing.

Test_Method: uv sync; npm ci; pytest; lint; build; generated-artifact freshness check.
